mapper.select: SELECT id, job_code, request_key, workspace_id, document_id, version_no, index_input_revision, job_type, status, stage, worker_token, running_lease_until, retry_count, next_retry_at, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_index_job WHERE request_key = #{requestKey} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, job_code, request_key, workspace_id, document_id, version_no, index_input_revision, job_type, status, stage, worker_token, running_lease_until, retry_count, next_retry_at, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_index_job WHERE job_code = #{jobCode} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, job_code, request_key, workspace_id, document_id, version_no, index_input_revision, job_type, status, stage, worker_token, running_lease_until, retry_count, next_retry_at, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_index_job WHERE status = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_index_job SET status = 1, worker_token = #{workerToken}, running_lease_until = #{runningLeaseUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_code = #{jobCode} AND status = 0 AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)

UPDATE knowledge_index_job SET running_lease_until = #{runningLeaseUntil}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_code = #{jobCode} AND status = 1 AND worker_token = #{workerToken} AND running_lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT id, job_code, request_key, workspace_id, document_id, version_no, index_input_revision, job_type, status, stage, worker_token, running_lease_until, retry_count, next_retry_at, failure_reason, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_index_job WHERE status = 1 AND running_lease_until <= #{now} ORDER BY running_lease_until ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_index_job SET status = 4, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, running_lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_code = #{jobCode} AND worker_token = #{workerToken} AND status = 1

UPDATE knowledge_index_job SET status = 2, running_lease_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_code = #{jobCode} AND worker_token = #{workerToken} AND status = 1 AND running_lease_until > #{now}

UPDATE knowledge_index_job SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, status = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetryCount} THEN 3 ELSE 0 END, worker_token = NULL, running_lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN retry_count + 1 >= #{maxRetryCount} THEN NULL ELSE DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{retryDelaySeconds} SECOND) END, failure_reason = #{failureReason}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE job_code = #{jobCode} AND status = 1 AND worker_token = #{workerToken} AND running_lease_until > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
